amenitiesDescription: Over 57,000 square feet of curated amenities spans three levels, anchored by the signature Palm Tree Club venue at ground level with culinary and entertainment programming curated by Palm Tree Crew's artist network. The Palm Tree Beach Club rooftop features a resort-style infinity pool, lounge bar with garden terrace, and a private members lounge. Wellness facilities include a Technogym-equipped fitness center with climbing wall, a movement studio for yoga and Pilates, and a spa with steam, sauna, cold plunge, and private treatment rooms. A double padel court, a golf simulator, juice bar, valet, house cruiser bikes, and 24-hour concierge complete the offering.
description: Designed by Kobi Karp Architecture, Palm Tree Residences is a 37-story tower of 483 fully finished, furnished turnkey homes in Miami's Entertainment District. Floor plans span junior suites through three-bedroom residences with Italkraft kitchens, Miele appliances, and Waterworks baths. A PMG and Palm Tree Crew collaboration pairing yield-flexible short-term rental product with a globally recognized lifestyle brand.

signals.title: PMG's Entertainment District Dominance
signals.body: The developer has already pioneered and proven the ultra-luxury short-term rental model in this immediate corridor with historic sellouts at E11EVEN Hotel & Residences and West Eleventh. Palm Tree Residences executes that exact same liquid, high-occupancy playbook under optimized Entertainment District zoning.

signals.title: Kygo's Palm Tree Crew lifestyle ecosystem
signals.body: The brand produces festivals in St. Tropez, Aspen, the Hamptons, and Napa, anchoring cultural moments from F1 Miami to Art Basel. Ownership functions as an exclusive lifestyle passport with VIP access to curated global activations.

signals.title: Festival and venue privileges worldwide
signals.body: Ownership unlocks priority festival access, expedited entry at PTC venues, and weekday dining at Palm Tree Club Miami—extending asset utility beyond the unit through an exclusive lifestyle passport.

signals.title: Turnkey STR product at scale
signals.body: Operators can list at delivery with hospitality-grade Italkraft, Miele, and Waterworks specifications throughout — consistent, rental-ready product with no variable finish quality across the tower.

investmentThesis: Sited in Miami's Entertainment District, the tower operates under zoning that permits short-term rentals without the minimum-lease restrictions typical of Miami condominiums. Turnkey delivery—fully finished, furnished, and rent-ready—removes fit-out risk and accelerates time-to-revenue for income-oriented buyers. Over 57,000 square feet of hospitality-driven amenity programming across three levels supports occupancy economics and guest experience at scale.
name: Palm Tree Residences Miami
ownerBenefits:
Palm Tree Residences Miami is the first residential address from Palm Tree Crew, the global lifestyle platform founded by Kygo and Myles Shear and the producer of the Palm Tree Music Festival across West Palm Beach, Aspen, the Hamptons, St. Tropez, Napa Valley, Montreal, Singapore and beyond. Here, ownership is not just an address. It is your way into that calendar.

Palm Tree Club events and venues. Priority access to Palm Tree Festivals, with preferred ticketing and table opportunities. Dedicated, expedited entry at PTC venues and preferred ticket pricing across select venues. Weekday dining privileges at Palm Tree Club Miami, on the ground floor of your own building, plus access to members-only tables, lounges and premium viewing decks.

In residence. A dedicated concierge who works across the entire Palm Tree Crew ecosystem, curated programming from wellness activations to resident and guest events, signature merchandise, and residents-only online discounts.

No other tower in Miami comes with this access. Request current pricing and availability below.

residenceContent: Designed by the renowned Kobi Karp Architecture, Palm Tree Residences is a striking 37-story tower offering 483 fully finished and furnished turnkey homes. Floor plans range from efficient junior suites to expansive three-bedroom residences, with select configurations featuring custom Murphy beds for maximum layout flexibility. High-specification interiors include designer kitchens by Italkraft with fully integrated Miele appliances, alongside spa-inspired bathrooms outfitted with Waterworks fixtures and custom vanities. Every residence features a private balcony with skyline views and fully built-out closets. A collaboration between Property Markets Group (PMG) and Kygo's Palm Tree Crew, the development seamlessly capitalizes on Miami's high-demand short-term rental market by pairing a yield-flexible asset with a globally recognized lifestyle brand.
statusRemark: Publicly announced May 2026. Current release from the low-$600s.
tagline: The world's first Palm Tree Residences by PMG and Palm Tree Crew, offering short-term rental flexibility in Miami's Entertainment District.
